**Optimizations applied:**
- **Double buffering**: Two sets of shared memory (A_smem0/A_smem1, B_smem0/B_smem1) enable overlapping loads with computation
- **K-loop unrolled by 2**: Step size is 32 (2×BLOCK_K) instead of 16, halving loop iterations from 512 to 256

**Structure**: Each loop iteration processes two K-tiles (32 K-elements) in two phases — Phase 1 loads buf1 and computes from buf0, Phase 2 loads buf0 and computes from buf1 — with `al.syncthreads()` between phases to ensure data completion.
